title: User Login and Dashboard Access
description: Verify that users can login successfully and access the React-based dashboard tailored to their role and tenant.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input valid username and password for a tenant-specific user
Click login button
Check login is successful and dashboard loads with tenant-specific data
Verify dashboard components render according to user role and permissions

title: Login Failure with Invalid Credentials
description: Check that login fails with invalid or missing credentials and appropriate error messages are displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input invalid username or password
Click login button
Verify login is rejected and an error message is displayed

title: Dynamic Form Configuration Create and Update
description: Test that hospital staff can create and modify form configurations including adding/hiding fields, and setting validations and workflows without developer intervention.

steps.description: Login as hospital staff user with form configuration privileges
Navigate to Form Configurator UI
Create a new form configuration including fields, validations, and workflow rules
Verify the new form configuration is saved and versioned
Modify the form by hiding fields and changing validations
Verify updates are saved and previous versions remain accessible for rollback

title: Form Configuration Rollback Functionality
description: Verify rollback functionality of form configurations works correctly within 5 minutes after changes.

steps.description: Create or modify a form configuration
Initiate rollback to a previous form configuration version
Confirm the form configuration reverted successfully and matches the selected version

title: Patient Management - CRUD Operations
description: Validate creation, retrieval, update, and deletion of patient records via API and UI, ensuring external ID and custom data management.

steps.description: Create a patient record with valid external ID and custom data through the API
Verify patient record is created successfully and accessible
Retrieve patient list and confirm created record is present
Update patient details via API and UI
Confirm updates persist correctly in the system
Delete patient record
Verify patient record is removed and no longer accessible

title: Visit Management - Status Tracking and Updates
description: Test visit creation, status tracking, and status update functionality with both API and UI components.

steps.description: Create a new patient visit with status via Visit Management API
Verify visit is listed with correct details
Retrieve visit details by visit ID
Confirm visit details match input data
Update visit status using the API endpoint
Check the visit status reflects updated state
Access Visits UI pages and confirm UI reflects status updates

title: Consent Management Creation and Compliance
description: Validate that consents can be created, listed, and audited, ensuring DPDP and ABDM compliance and audit trails are recorded.

steps.description: Create new consent with valid patient ID, purpose, and data categories via API
Verify consent creation returns correct status and stored data
List existing consents and confirm new consent is included
Check audit trail logs reflect the consent creation
Confirm audit logs comply with DPDP and ABDM standards
Use Consent UI to view and manage consents
Verify UI shows consistent consent information with backend

title: Consent Validation for Operations
description: Check consent verification endpoint for read/write operations with various consent scenarios.

steps.description: Request consent check for a patient, purpose, and data categories where consent exists and action is allowed
Response confirms consent granted
Request consent check where consent is missing or insufficient
Response indicates consent denial

title: RBAC Enforcement at Field, Record, and Workflow Levels
description: Validate that access control is enforced correctly for users at multiple granularities using the RBAC system.

steps.description: Fetch user permissions via API for various roles (doctor, nurse, admin)
Verify permissions include correct scopes at field, record, and workflow levels
Attempt access to restricted fields, records, and workflows from UI and API
Validate that access is denied appropriately with error messages or hidden fields
Test permission changes propagate dynamic enforcement without full system restart
Confirm immediate and correct permission enforcement

title: Form Submission Idempotency and Duplication Prevention
description: Test submission gateway prevents duplicate form submissions using idempotency keys and performs validation.

steps.description: Submit form data with valid payload and unique Idempotency-Key header
Submission succeeds and data saved
Repeate submission with the same Idempotency-Key
Verify duplicate submission is rejected or ignored
Submit form with missing or invalid mandatory fields
Submission fails with validation error messages

title: Orchestration Workflow Execution and Retry
description: Check that orchestrator can execute workflows, manage tasks, send notifications, and retry failed tasks.

steps.description: Trigger orchestration process execution via API
Verify processing starts and completes successfully
Simulate task failure within a workflow
Request retry of failed tasks
Confirm task retries run and complete successfully
Check notifications list API for relevant notifications generated during process
Verify notifications delivered to intended recipients

title: Multi-Tenancy Data Isolation and Customization
description: Validate users from different tenants can only access their own data and configurations are tenant-specific.

steps.description: Login as a user from one tenant and attempt to retrieve another tenant's patient or visit data via API and UI
Access denied or empty results confirming data isolation
Create form configurations in one tenant and verify configurations are not visible or accessible in other tenants
Confirm tenant-level customization scope enforcement

title: Extensions System Runtime Hook Execution
description: Test extensions system for runtime hooks and event subscriptions enabling external integrations.

steps.description: Register a runtime extension with hook and event subscriptions
Trigger corresponding events via form submission or workflow execution
Verify extension hooks receive and process events correctly
Check external integration effects or responses

title: Performance - Sub-second Form Loading
description: Measure form loading performance to verify sub-second response time under normal and peak load conditions.

steps.description: Request form configuration and form rendering via UI multiple times in normal load
Verify response times are consistently below 1000 ms
Simulate peak concurrent users accessing forms
Confirm system maintains sub-second load times and no error responses

title: Audit Trail Integrity for All Data Changes
description: Verify audit trails capture all changes to patient data, consent, roles, form configs, and workflows maintaining compliance and data integrity.

steps.description: Make changes to patient records, consent, RBAC roles, and workflow configurations
Check audit logs reflect all actions with correct timestamp, user info, and before/after states
Attempt unauthorized changes and verify they are blocked and logged
Confirm compliance with DPDP and ABDM audit requirements
